title: Ibiza Club Cherry Menthol 50/50  E-Liquid - 6mg
description: Ibiza Club’s Cherry Menthol is an absolutely irresistible candy flavour with a refreshing twist. The bold, sweet taste of juicy Cherry candy is laced with ice-cold menthol for a cool and delicious all-day vape. The 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol ratio delivers a sublime balance of clouds, vapour and flavour and is ideal for use with starter vape kits, compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits. 50/50 e-liquids are the perfect choice for vapers seeking the best of all worlds from their e-liquids. This e-liquid offers a perfect balance of PG and VG. PG, or Propylene Glycol, is an e-liquid ingredient that’s used to carry flavour as well as providing that tactile, satisfying throat hit that makes vaping such an effective substitute for smoking. VG, of Vegetable Glycerin, produces more vapour than PG so better recreates the curls and clouds of smoke that smokers are familiar with from cigarettes. Ibiza Club celebrates summer all year round by creating wonderful E-Liquids that bring a little Mediterranean sunshine to some truly classic e-liquid flavours. These 50/50 e-liquids create a party of flavour on your tastebuds with their perfect balance of flavour, vapour and throat hit and offer great value to experienced and non-experienced vapers alike. Why not try other classic flavours in Ibiza Club’s sun-soaked collection, including Cherry Menthol, Blue Raspberry and Apple and Blackcurrant.
